items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: They couldn't recognize Mozart from Beethoven.

ctx.x: Because very few of the older New Orleans musicians know anything about Classical music whatsoever. They know more about Motown music or any crazy...Country-and-Western Music. But Classical music, very few of them know anything about it. They couldn't recognize Mozart from Beethoven. And I wonder if there was anywhere else in New Orleans that you could hear Classical music after the French Opera burned down. But you say no.

No. Well, a lot of it ended. But the thing about it which was a good thing, that Opera left... A lot of those good musicians stayed in New Orleans and taught, you see. One of the great Black musicians you don't hear about, that could play Classics, was named P.G. Laurie -- he had a band on the Ringling Brothers Circus. He wasn't from New Orleans. But he was a good trumpet player. Riddell(?) Clark, who is one of your great trumpet virtuosos, who lives in Long Beach, says P.G. Laurie(?) was one of your great…
